name: Collateral Type 22 Choice
definition: Choice element between specific and general collateral.

GeneralCollateral.name: General Collateral
GeneralCollateral.definition: Allows for the sale and repurchase of any of a selection of assets from a pool of eligible assets.

SpecificCollateral.name: Specific Collateral
SpecificCollateral.definition: A single, pre defined, financial instrument is sold and repurchased.
